content.value:
To spin in place, set all left-side motors forward and all right-side motors backward.

With a mecanum drive, use ALL 4 motors: front_left + back_left go one direction, front_right + back_right go the opposite. Pure rotation.

The left and right motors are bolted onto opposite sides of the robot, so they are mirror images of each other.

Positive power on a left motor spins its wheel backward, while positive power on a right motor spins its wheel forward.

If you don't account for this, 'left motors forward, right motors backward' will not actually spin the robot.

Fix it by reversing the left-side motors so positive power means 'wheel forward' on every wheel.

Now that the left motors are reversed, positive power means 'forward' on all four wheels.

In loop(), set the left motors to 0.5 and the right motors to -0.5. This spins the robot clockwise.
Use getRuntime() to detect when 1.5 seconds have passed, then set all four motors to 0.0.
